_README.description: Moonshot Kimi via its OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, MOONSHOT_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Base URL https://api.moonshot.ai/v1. Kimi K3 weights are open but 2.8T, so the API is the practical route. Scores pinned to the moonshotai/* OpenRouter mirrors. Verify model IDs against /models if a call 404s.

models.description: Moonshot Kimi K3 - flagship agentic MoE (2.8T, 1M context). Direct Moonshot API. Score at the high-effort anchor is interpolated: AA has no high row (low 30, max 44), so high is taken as about 37.
